After candidate Graham Platner dropped out due to scandal, Maine Democrats held a quick convention to select Troy Jackson as their new nominee against Susan Collins.

The rapid replacement process suggests the party is more focused on winning the seat than vetting the underlying culture of their candidates.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the WHY plane; the narrative of 'grassroots energy' masks the necessity of a quick political fix.

Social Physics Analysis:
The party used a top-down convention process to consolidate support quickly. This is a defensive maneuver to prevent further loss of momentum.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. The party is rebranding to maintain power.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political parties prioritize winning over ideological purity.

The Unavoidable Lie: This was a purely organic grassroots movement.
